title: Melbourne Leo Lion:
title_q: “I Cannot Imagine My Life Without Him”
headline: A Leo Lion met her mentor two and a half years ago; they talk every day, and she cannot imagine her life without him.
story: Atdhe asks if anyone in her club is like family. Her answer is one person: her mentor. They connected the day they met, two and a half years ago. Every day since, they are in touch, and he helped her develop her skills. She cannot imagine her life without him.

The last quarter ties it back: 14 years ago she joined, and today she is a Leo Lion from the Lions Club of Brighton in Melbourne. She ends with her message: be kind, make more friends, help people in need. Warm and bright.

decisions.b: She was born in Bitola, North Macedonia and lives in Melbourne. The Monday item calls her “Manastir”, which she never says. This plan pins “📍 Melbourne, Australia”, her club's city. Atdhe can switch it to Bitola.

Jacqui does not want the Maryland template graphics (“AI style flyers”). She asked for much simpler graphics or none at all. Atdhe has to pick one look for the whole Hong Kong batch. This blueprint uses captions and a small location pin only.
On hold, or live? The board shows a live deadline, but the brief doc is marked “Status: ON HOLD… nobody is working to it”. Atdhe or Nick must confirm before Bleron starts.
Jacqui left notes on the sound bites of the Maryland cut in Frame.io. Nobody has read them yet. Read them before locking bites here, in case they apply to the whole batch.

client_note: Why this matters: Hong Kong cuts lead with friendship. Hers is one person, a mentor she talks to every day. No other subject has that story. Ledger tag: PERSONAL-TRANSFORMATION, sub-angle “a mentor who grew her skills and is in touch every day” (Uganda is “from looking for belonging to a best friend who leads the club”).
